subject: Kickoff & MAP request — Redwood integration
messages:
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@aperturehealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff & MAP request — Redwood integration

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and the quantization options. We ready to move toward a pilot and procurement needs a mutual action plan (MAP) and a timeline they can review alongside the SOW.

High-level asks from our side:
- 4-week pilot timeline with clear milestone owners
- Data ingress checklist (PHI scope flagged) and security artifacts we can share with procurement (SOC 2 scope, retention, access controls)
- Acceptance criteria for pass/fail of the pilot and cutover window options

Can you share a MAP template and a proposed schedule? We need something procurement can attach to their packet — they asked for dates and owners rather than vague phase names.

Procurement lead: Kyle Morgan (kyle.morgan@aperturehealth.com) — please include him on any SOW/contract notes.

Looking forward — can we target a kickoff week of Mar 27–31?

Best,
Samantha Ruiz
Head of Integrations
Aperture Health

Attachments: none
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff & MAP request — Redwood integration

Hi Samantha — great to hear and thanks for the clear asks.

I've attached a compact MAP template (MAP_v0.1.xlsx) with milestone rows you can review. Proposed pilot cadence below (we can shift dates if you need):
- Week 0 (kickoff): Mar 28 — project kickoff, access provisioning (Owner: Diego Fernandez)
- Week 1: Data ingestion & schema validation (Owner: Aperture data eng + Redwood integration lead)
- Week 2: Model validation + prompt tuning (Owner: Ben Carter)
- Week 3: End-to-end acceptance testing + performance tuning (Owner: Marissa Cole)
- Week 4: Cutover window & post-launch review (Owner: Customer ops + Redwood CS)

Acceptance criteria draft: data completeness, <1.5s 95th p50/p95 latency for pilot load, and no PII leakage in outputs. I'll ask Ben to take the MAP and add owner names and concrete dates.

I'll include the SOC 2 excerpt we can share with procurement and loop in Marissa for acceptance criteria and cutover cadence. Proposed kickoff: Mar 28 (Wednesday) at 10am PT. Does that work for you and Kyle?

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet, MAP template stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@aperturehealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft + SOW draft for Aperture Health

Thanks Diego — attaching MAP_Aperture_v1.xlsx and a preliminary SOW (SOW_draft_for_review.pdf) for procurement. I populated milestone owners and concrete dates based on Diego's proposed cadence. Key milestones below (owners & target dates):

- Kickoff & access provisioning — Diego Fernandez — 2028-03-28
- Data ingestion complete (sample set loaded) — Aperture data eng (Kyle M.) — 2028-04-03
- Model validation & prompt tuning complete — Ben Carter — 2028-04-10
- Integration QA & latency testing — Marissa Cole — 2028-04-14
- Pilot review & decision to go/no-go — Aperture ops + Redwood CS — 2028-04-18
- Production cutover (if green) — target week of 2028-04-22 (cutover window TBD)

Notes:
- We've included a conservative 2-day buffer between validation and QA to allow for tuning. If you want model validation moved earlier (to help procurement), we can compress Week 2 and Week 3.
- For procurement: SOW contains standard terms; procurement should expect a DocuSign link after final review.

I'll be on the kickoff and will take owner responsibility for model validation tasks. Marissa will handle QA cadence and acceptance gating. Please flag any conflicts.

Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Aperture_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_draft_for_review.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@aperturehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-23T16:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + SOW draft for Aperture Health

Thanks team — reviewed Ben's draft and added an acceptance checklist and risk register (see implementation_risks_and_mitigation.docx). A few clarifications and asks before we lock dates:

1) Data ingress: we need a sample dataset with schema and a test S3 bucket account by Mar 31 to hit the current schedule. Aperture team: can you confirm a point of contact and whether the sample contains PHI?
2) Cutover windows: propose two nightly cutover windows (10pm–2am PT or 2am–6am PT) — we should pick one during the pilot to rehearse.
3) Monitoring & rollback: we'll provide a runbook with explicit rollback criteria; Marissa will own the runbook creation and the go/no-go checklist.

Proposed small change: move the integration QA earlier by 48 hours (to 2028-04-12) to allow a follow-up tuning day before pilot review. If that works for Aperture, I'll update the MAP.

Marissa Cole
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: implementation_risks_and_mitigation.docx (docx stub)
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@aperturehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@aperturehealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-24T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + SOW draft for Aperture Health

Appreciate the fast turn. Quick responses from our side:
- Kyle confirmed he can provision sample S3 access and will coordinate with our data engineering lead — sample may contain limited PHI; we will flag fields and provide a redacted sample if needed.
- We prefer the 10pm–2am PT cutover window for rehearsals.
- Please move Model validation by two days earlier (Ben) if possible — that helps our QA planning and procurement.

Also, can Redwood produce a 1-page technical executive summary and a short note for our CTO summarizing SLA, latency targets, and data controls? If you can send that ahead of DocuSign, procurement will expedite review.

We agree to the tentative dates pending the updated MAP that reflects the two-day shift and the earlier QA date. If you can send updated MAP + DocuSign link for the SOW, Kyle will route to procurement.

Thanks,
Samantha Ruiz
Head of Integrations
Aperture Health

Attachments: none
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@aperturehealth.com>, Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP_Aperture_v2, exec summary, and SOW next steps

Thanks Samantha — updated per your asks and Kyle's provisioning note. Attached: MAP_Aperture_v2.xlsx (finalized dates/owners), and a 1-page exec summary. Key changes from v1: model validation moved earlier by 2 days, integration QA set to 2028-04-12, monitoring runbook owner assigned (Marissa), cutover rehearsal window confirmed at 10pm–2am PT.

DocuSign link for the SOW (SOW_draft_for_review.pdf) is here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/StartInSigning.aspx?ac=0A1B2C_SOW_Aperture — procurement can sign and we will enact the reserved pilot capacity upon countersignature.

Weekly cadence:
- Weekly status sync, Wednesdays 10am PT (Ben + Aperture ops)
- Tech deep-dive, Fridays 9am PT during pilot (Diego + Aperture data eng)
- Post-pilot review on 2028-04-18 at 11am PT (stakeholders)

Can you confirm acceptance of MAP_Aperture_v2 and the DocuSign path by EOD 2028-04-02 so procurement has time to process?

Thanks — looking forward to kick off.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Aperture_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), exec_summary_onepager.pdf (pdf stub), SOW_docusign_link (link stub)
